# Purpose

This document contains the downstream R analyses used for the manuscript:

The Oropharyngeal Microbiome in Remote-Living Australian Children with and without Group A Streptococcal Infection

The workflow begins from the processed ASV/taxonomy data and study metadata, additionally MaAslin 2 tables. Raw PacBio sequence processing and taxonomic assignment were performed using the bioinformatics workflow described in the manuscript and are not reproduced here.

# 1. Setup

```{r setup}
library(phyloseq)
library(vegan)
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggdist)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(patchwork)
library(grid)

set.seed(123)

```

# 2. Import processed data

```{r import-data}

# Import all data

# Main decontam-filtered phyloseq object


physeq <- readRDS(
  "data/physeq.rds"
)


# Biological samples only
physeq_bio <- subset_samples(
  physeq,
  !is.na(Timepoint)
)

physeq_bio <- prune_taxa(
  taxa_sums(physeq_bio) > 0,
  physeq_bio
)


# Clinical metadata

clinical <- read.csv(
  "data/clinical_metadata.csv",
  row.names = 1,
  check.names = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Remove duplicated column names
clinical <- clinical[
  ,
  !duplicated(names(clinical)),
  drop = FALSE
]

# Preserve sample ID
clinical$Sample_ID <- rownames(clinical)

# column names used throughout this R Markdown
if (!"GAS_isolated" %in% names(clinical) &&
    "GASIsolated" %in% names(clinical)) {
  
  clinical$GAS_isolated <- clinical$GASIsolated
}

if (!"Event_name" %in% names(clinical) &&
    "EventName" %in% names(clinical)) {
  
  clinical$Event_name <- clinical$EventName
}

if (!"sample_id" %in% names(clinical)) {
  clinical$sample_id <- clinical$Sample_ID
}

# Final checks
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(names(clinical)))

stopifnot(
  all(
    c(
      "participant_id",
      "GAS_isolated",
      "Event_name",
      "Shannon",
      "Richness"
    ) %in% names(clinical)
  )
)

# qPCR data

qpcr <- read.csv(
  "data/qpcr_data.csv",
  row.names = 1,
  check.names = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

qpcr$Sample_ID <- rownames(qpcr)


qpcr_analysis <- qpcr %>%
  filter(
    Sample_or_Control == "True Sample",
    GASIsolated %in% c("No", "Yes"),
    !is.na(copies_per_ul)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    log10_load = log10(copies_per_ul),
    GASIsolated = factor(
      GASIsolated,
      levels = c("No", "Yes")
    ),
    Timepoint = factor(
      Timepoint,
      levels = c(1, 2)
    )
  )



# Mean relative-abundance barplot inputs


metadata <- read_excel(
  "data/barplot_metadata.xlsx",
  na = "NA"
) %>%
  select(sample_id, participant_id, EventName)

otu_raw <- read_csv(
  "data/barplot_otu.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

# First column contains sample IDs
names(otu_raw)[1] <- "sample_id"

otu_counts <- otu_raw %>%
  select(sample_id, starts_with("Otu")) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    -sample_id,
    names_to = "otu",
    values_to = "count"
  )

taxonomy <- read_tsv(
  "data/barplot_taxonomy.txt",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
# PCoA inputs

pcoa_asv <- read.csv(
  "data/NMDS_otu.csv",
  row.names = 1,
  check.names = FALSE
)

analysis_metadata <- read.csv(
  "data/NMDS_metadata.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE
)

# Use sample IDs as metadata row names
rownames(analysis_metadata) <- analysis_metadata$sample_id

# Confirm that the same samples are present
stopifnot(
  setequal(
    colnames(pcoa_asv),
    rownames(analysis_metadata)
  )
)
# MaAsLin inputs and results


maaslin_results <- read.delim(
  "data/maaslin_results.tsv",
  header = TRUE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE
)

maaslin_abundance <- read.csv(
  "data/maaslin_abundance.csv",
  header = TRUE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = TRUE
)

maaslin_metadata <- read.csv(
  "data/maaslin_metadata.csv",
  header = TRUE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE
)



# Basic checks


cat("Biological samples:", nsamples(physeq_bio), "\n")
cat("Microbial features:", ntaxa(physeq_bio), "\n")
cat("Clinical metadata rows:", nrow(clinical), "\n")
cat("qPCR analysis rows:", nrow(qpcr_analysis), "\n")
cat("MaAsLin results:", nrow(maaslin_results), "\n")
```

# 3. Figure 3A

```{r Fig 3A}
## Figure 3A: Species prevalence and mean relative abundance

# Collapse ASVs to species level
physeq_species <- tax_glom(
  physeq_bio,
  taxrank = "Species",
  NArm = FALSE
)

# Convert counts to relative abundance within each sample
physeq_rel <- transform_sample_counts(
  physeq_species,
  function(x) x / sum(x)
)

# Convert phyloseq object to long-format dataframe
df_rel <- psmelt(physeq_rel)

# Calculate species prevalence and mean relative abundance
# Prevalence is defined as the percentage of samples in which
# relative abundance exceeds 0.1% (0.001 as a proportion)
taxa_summary <- df_rel %>%
  group_by(Species) %>%
  summarise(
    prevalence = mean(Abundance > 0.001) * 100,
    mean_RA = mean(Abundance) * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Species),
    Species != ""
  )

# Retain taxa with prevalence >= 30% for visualisation
taxa_plot <- taxa_summary %>%
  filter(
    prevalence >= 30,
    mean_RA > 0
  )

# Species selected for labelling in the figure
labels_to_show <- c(
  "Streptococcus salivarius",
  "Prevotella_7 melaninogenica",
  "Neisseria subflava",
  "Prevotella_7 histicola",
  "Leptotrichia wadei A",
  "Veillonella nakazawae",
  "Gemella haemolysans A",
  "Fusobacterium periodonticum B",
  "Porphyromonas sp000467855",
  "Alloprevotella sp900095835"
)

# Add labels only to selected taxa
taxa_plot <- taxa_plot %>%
  mutate(
    label = ifelse(
      Species %in% labels_to_show,
      Species,
      NA
    )
  )

# Generate bubble plot
p_fig1 <- ggplot(
  taxa_plot,
  aes(
    x = prevalence,
    y = mean_RA,
    size = mean_RA,
    colour = prevalence
  )
) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = label),
    na.rm = TRUE,
    size = 3.5,
    max.overlaps = 100,
    box.padding = 0.4,
    point.padding = 0.25,
    segment.color = "grey50"
  ) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  scale_colour_viridis_c(
    option = "plasma"
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Prevalence (% samples; RA > 0.1%)",
    y = "Mean relative abundance (%) [log scale]",
    size = "Mean RA (%)",
    colour = "Prevalence (%)"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(
      size = 12,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.text = element_text(
      size = 10
    ),
    legend.title = element_text(
      size = 10,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    legend.text = element_text(
      size = 9
    )
  ) +
  guides(
    colour = guide_colourbar(order = 1),
    size = guide_legend(order = 2)
  )

# Display Figure 1
p_fig1

```

# 5. Figure 4A

```{r }
##Figure 4A: Mean relative abundance of barplot of top taxa

##load table ###


otu_rel_abund <- inner_join(
  metadata,
  otu_counts,
  by = "sample_id"
) %>%
  inner_join(
    taxonomy,
    by = "otu"
  ) %>%
  group_by(sample_id) %>%
  mutate(
    rel_abund = count / sum(count)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-count) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      kingdom,
      phylum,
      class,
      order,
      family,
      genus,
      species
    ),
    names_to = "level",
    values_to = "taxon"
  )


# Calculate species-level relative abundance within each sample


taxon_rel_abund <- otu_rel_abund %>%
  filter(level == "species") %>%
  group_by(
    sample_id,
    taxon,
    participant_id,
    EventName
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    rel_abund = sum(rel_abund),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    mean_rel_abund = 100 * rel_abund,
    taxon = str_replace(
      taxon,
      "(.*)_unclassified",
      "Unclassified *\\1*"
    ),
    taxon = str_replace(
      taxon,
      "^(\\S*)$",
      "*\\1*"
    )
  )



# Identify low-abundance taxa to pool as "Other"

# Taxa with a maximum relative abundance below 15% are pooled.

taxon_pool <- taxon_rel_abund %>%
  group_by(taxon) %>%
  summarise(
    pool = max(mean_rel_abund) < 15,
    mean = mean(mean_rel_abund),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# Pool low-abundance taxa within each individual sample


barplot_sample <- taxon_rel_abund %>%
  inner_join(
    taxon_pool,
    by = "taxon"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    taxon = if_else(
      pool,
      "Other",
      taxon
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    taxon,
    sample_id,
    participant_id,
    EventName
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_rel_abund = sum(mean_rel_abund),
    mean = min(mean),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# Calculate mean relative abundance across samples at each timepoint


barplot_mean <- barplot_sample %>%
  group_by(
    EventName,
    taxon
  ) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_rel_abund = mean(mean_rel_abund),
    mean = mean(mean),
    .groups = "drop"
  )



# Plot mean species-level relative abundance by sampling timepoint


barplot_mean %>%
  mutate(
    taxon = factor(taxon),
    taxon = fct_reorder(
      taxon,
      mean
    )
  ) %>%
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = EventName,
      y = mean_rel_abund,
      fill = taxon
    )
  ) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(
    name = NULL,
    values = c(
      brewer.pal(8, "Paired"),
      "gray",
      "coral4",
      "forestgreen",
      "brown",
      "aquamarine2",
      "chocolate1",
      "gray26",
      "cornflowerblue",
      "cornsilk4",
      "darkblue",
      "darkgoldenrod1",
      "darkmagenta",
      "darkorange",
      "darkorchid",
      "firebrick",
      "slateblue",
      "violetred3",
      "seagreen1",
      "springgreen2",
      "olivedrab4",
      "limegreen",
      "mediumseagreen",
      "darkgreen",
      "forestgreen",
      "gray26"
    )
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    limits = c(
      "Screening_Visit_1",
      "Screening_Visit_2"
    )
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 100),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Sampling Timepoint",
    y = "Mean Relative Abundance (%)"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_text(
      size = 10,
      color = "black",
      face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(
      size = 10,
      color = "black",
      face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.title.x = element_text(
      size = 10,
      color = "black",
      face = "bold"
    ),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.text = element_text(
      size = 10
    ),
    legend.box.spacing = unit(
      1.5,
      "cm"
    )
  )
```

# 6. Figure 4B

```{r}
## Figure 4B: Within-child versus Between-child Bray-Curtis dissimilarity

# Calculate Bray-Curtis dissimilarity


bray_dist <- phyloseq::distance(
  physeq_bio,
  method = "bray"
)

bray_matrix <- as.matrix(bray_dist)



# Extract sample metadata


meta_bray <- data.frame(
  sample_data(physeq_bio)
)

meta_bray$sample_id <- rownames(meta_bray)



#Convert Bray-Curtis matrix to pairwise long format


bray_pairs <- as.data.frame(
  as.table(bray_matrix),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    sample1 = Var1,
    sample2 = Var2,
    bray = Freq
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    sample1 != sample2
  )



# Add metadata for both samples in each pair


meta_1 <- meta_bray %>%
  dplyr::select(
    sample_id,
    participant_id,
    Timepoint
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    sample1 = sample_id,
    participant1 = participant_id,
    timepoint1 = Timepoint
  )

meta_2 <- meta_bray %>%
  dplyr::select(
    sample_id,
    participant_id,
    Timepoint
  ) %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    sample2 = sample_id,
    participant2 = participant_id,
    timepoint2 = Timepoint
  )

bray_pairs <- bray_pairs %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    meta_1,
    by = "sample1"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    meta_2,
    by = "sample2"
  )


# Remove duplicated sample-pair comparisons


bray_pairs <- bray_pairs %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    pair_id = purrr::map2_chr(
      sample1,
      sample2,
      ~ paste(sort(c(.x, .y)), collapse = "__")
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(
    pair_id,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  )



 #Define within-child longitudinal comparisons

within_child <- bray_pairs %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    participant1 == participant2,
    timepoint1 != timepoint2
  ) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    comparison = "Within-child",
    bray = bray
  )


# Define between-child baseline comparisons

between_child <- bray_pairs %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    participant1 != participant2,
    timepoint1 == 1,
    timepoint2 == 1
  ) %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    comparison = "Between-child",
    bray = bray
  )



# Combine comparison groups


bray_comparison <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  within_child,
  between_child
)


#  Summarise Bray-Curtis dissimilarity


bray_summary <- bray_comparison %>%
  dplyr::group_by(comparison) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    n = dplyr::n(),
    mean = mean(bray),
    median = median(bray),
    sd = sd(bray),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

bray_summary


#  Compare within-child and between-child dissimilarity


wilcox_bray <- wilcox.test(
  bray ~ comparison,
  data = bray_comparison,
  exact = FALSE
)

wilcox_bray


# Prepare data for plotting


set.seed(123)

between_plot <- between_child %>%
  dplyr::slice_sample(
    n = 600
  )

plot_data <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  within_child,
  between_plot
)

plot_data$comparison <- factor(
  plot_data$comparison,
  levels = c(
    "Within-child",
    "Between-child"
  )
)



# Plot


ggplot(
  plot_data,
  aes(
    x = comparison,
    y = bray,
    colour = comparison
  )
) +
  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.55,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    fill = NA
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.16,
    alpha = 0.45,
    size = 0.5
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 1.5,
    y = 1.02,
    label = "Wilcoxon p < 0.001",
    size = 3.5
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "Within-child" = "#0072B2",
      "Between-child" = "#D55E00"
    )
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0.38, 1.04),
    breaks = c(
      0.4,
      0.6,
      0.8,
      1.0
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Bray-Curtis dissimilarity"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      size = 11,
      colour = "black",
      face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(
      size = 10,
      colour = "black"
    ),
    axis.title.y = element_text(
      size = 11,
      colour = "black",
      face = "bold"
    ),
    legend.position = "none"
  )
  

```

## 7. Figure 4C

```{r}
## Figure 4C: Change in Shannon diversity at T1 and T2

# Calculate Shannon diversity


alpha_div <- phyloseq::estimate_richness(
  physeq_bio,
  measures = "Shannon"
)

alpha_div$sample_id <- rownames(alpha_div)

# Extract metadata
meta_alpha <- data.frame(
  sample_data(physeq_bio)
)

meta_alpha$sample_id <- rownames(meta_alpha)

# Join Shannon diversity with participant metadata
alpha_div <- alpha_div %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    meta_alpha %>%
      dplyr::select(
        sample_id,
        participant_id,
        Timepoint
      ),
    by = "sample_id"
  )


# Retain participants sampled at both timepoints


alpha_paired <- alpha_div %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    Timepoint %in% c(1, 2)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(participant_id) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    dplyr::n_distinct(Timepoint) == 2
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()



# Create T1 and T2 plotting labels


alpha_paired <- alpha_paired %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Timepoint_label = dplyr::case_when(
      Timepoint == 1 ~ "T1",
      Timepoint == 2 ~ "T2"
    ),
    Timepoint_label = factor(
      Timepoint_label,
      levels = c("T1", "T2")
    )
  )



 # data for paired Wilcoxon test


alpha_wide <- alpha_paired %>%
  dplyr::select(
    participant_id,
    Timepoint_label,
    Shannon
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = Timepoint_label,
    values_from = Shannon
  ) %>%
  tidyr::drop_na(T1, T2)


#Paired Wilcoxon  test

wilcox_shannon <- wilcox.test(
  alpha_wide$T1,
  alpha_wide$T2,
  paired = TRUE,
  exact = FALSE
)

wilcox_shannon

# Plot 

ggplot(
  alpha_paired,
  aes(
    x = Timepoint_label,
    y = Shannon,
    group = participant_id
  )
) +
  geom_line(
    colour = "grey75",
    linewidth = 0.4,
    alpha = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(colour = Timepoint_label),
    size = 2.2,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  stat_summary(
    aes(group = Timepoint_label),
    fun = mean,
    geom = "point",
    shape = 21,
    size = 3.2,
    fill = "black",
    colour = "black"
  ) +
  stat_summary(
    aes(group = Timepoint_label),
    fun.data = mean_se,
    geom = "errorbar",
    width = 0.14,
    linewidth = 0.8,
    colour = "black"
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 1.5,
    y = max(alpha_paired$Shannon, na.rm = TRUE) + 0.1,
    label = "Wilcoxon p = 0.10",
    size = 3.5
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "T1" = "#0072B2",
      "T2" = "#D55E00"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Shannon diversity"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      size = 11,
      colour = "black",
      face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(
      size = 10,
      colour = "black"
    ),
    axis.title.y = element_text(
      size = 11,
      colour = "black",
      face = "bold"
    ),
    legend.position = "none"
  )
```

```{r}


# Figure 4D: PCoA of microbiome composition by timepoint

# Convert ASV abundance table to numeric
asv_num <- pcoa_asv %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      everything(),
      ~ parse_number(as.character(.x))
    )
  ) %>%
  as.data.frame()



# Align metadata to ASV table

# Samples are columns in the ASV table
stopifnot(
  setequal(
    colnames(asv_num),
    rownames(analysis_metadata)
  )
)

# Put metadata in exactly the same order as ASV table samples
metadata_pcoa <- analysis_metadata[
  colnames(asv_num),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

stopifnot(
  identical(
    colnames(asv_num),
    rownames(metadata_pcoa)
  )
)

cat(
  "Samples available for PCoA:",
  ncol(asv_num),
  "\n"
)



# Retain samples with required metadata

keep <- (
  !is.na(metadata_pcoa$Timepoint) &
  metadata_pcoa$Timepoint != "" &
  !is.na(metadata_pcoa$participant_id)
)

cat(
  "Samples excluded because of missing timepoint/participant:",
  sum(!keep),
  "\n"
)

asv_num <- asv_num[
  ,
  keep,
  drop = FALSE
]

metadata_pcoa <- metadata_pcoa[
  keep,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

stopifnot(
  identical(
    colnames(asv_num),
    rownames(metadata_pcoa)
  )
)



# Construct phyloseq object

# Rows = ASVs, columns = samples
OTU <- otu_table(
  as.matrix(asv_num),
  taxa_are_rows = TRUE
)

SAM <- sample_data(
  metadata_pcoa
)

ps <- phyloseq(
  OTU,
  SAM
)


# Remove zero-read samples if any
ps <- prune_samples(
  sample_sums(ps) > 0,
  ps
)


# Convert counts to relative abundance
ps_rel <- transform_sample_counts(
  ps,
  function(x) x / sum(x)
)



# Bray-Curtis distance and PCoA

dist_bc <- phyloseq::distance(
  ps_rel,
  method = "bray"
)

ord_bc <- ordinate(
  ps_rel,
  method = "PCoA",
  distance = dist_bc
)


# Variance explained by PCoA axes
eig <- ord_bc$values$Relative_eig

xlab <- paste0(
  "PCoA1 (",
  round(100 * eig[1], 1),
  "%)"
)

ylab <- paste0(
  "PCoA2 (",
  round(100 * eig[2], 1),
  "%)"
)



# Repeated-measures PERMANOVA

meta_perm <- data.frame(
  sample_data(ps_rel)
)

meta_perm <- meta_perm[
  labels(dist_bc),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

stopifnot(
  identical(
    rownames(meta_perm),
    labels(dist_bc)
  )
)

set.seed(123)

permanova_timepoint <- adonis2(
  dist_bc ~ Timepoint,
  data = meta_perm,
  permutations = 999,
  strata = meta_perm$participant_id
)

permanova_timepoint


# Extract values for figure annotation
permanova_r2 <- permanova_timepoint$R2[1]
permanova_p <- permanova_timepoint$`Pr(>F)`[1]

permanova_label <- paste0(
  "PERMANOVA R² = ",
  sprintf("%.3f", permanova_r2),
  ", p = ",
  ifelse(
    permanova_p < 0.001,
    "< 0.001",
    sprintf("%.3f", permanova_p)
  )
)



# Plot

p_pcoa_timepoint <- plot_ordination(
  ps_rel,
  ord_bc,
  color = "Timepoint"
) +
  
  geom_point(
    aes(fill = Timepoint),
    shape = 21,
    size = 3,
    alpha = 0.75,
    stroke = 0.5,
    colour = "black"
  ) +
  
  stat_ellipse(
    aes(
      group = Timepoint,
      fill = Timepoint,
      colour = Timepoint
    ),
    type = "norm",
    level = 0.95,
    geom = "polygon",
    alpha = 0.06,
    linewidth = 0.7,
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "TP1" = "#6879B8",
      "TP2" = "#E68632"
    )
  ) +
  
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
      "TP1" = "#6879B8",
      "TP2" = "#E68632"
    )
  ) +
  
  labs(
    x = xlab,
    y = ylab,
    fill = "Timepoint",
    colour = "Timepoint"
  ) +
  
  coord_equal() +
  
  theme_classic(
    base_size = 12
  ) +
  
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(
      size = 12,
      face = "bold",
      colour = "black"
    ),
    
    axis.text = element_text(
      size = 10,
      colour = "black"
    ),
    
    axis.ticks = element_line(
      linewidth = 0.4,
      colour = "black"
    ),
    
    legend.position = "right",
    
    legend.title = element_text(
      size = 11,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    
    legend.text = element_text(
      size = 10
    ),
    
    plot.margin = margin(
      6, 8, 6, 6
    )
  ) +
  
  guides(
    colour = "none",
    
    fill = guide_legend(
      title = "Timepoint",
      override.aes = list(
        shape = 21,
        size = 3.5,
        colour = "black",
        alpha = 0.8
      )
    )
  ) +
  
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = -Inf,
    y = Inf,
    label = permanova_label,
    hjust = -0.05,
    vjust = 1.5,
    size = 3.5
  )
```

```{r}
#Figure 5A: Alpha diversity plots for GAS status


# Prepare analysis dataset from clinical metadata
alpha_gas <- clinical %>%
  filter(
    GAS_isolated %in% c("No", "Yes"),
    !is.na(Shannon),
    !is.na(Richness),

# Colour palette

  "No"  = "#F28E00"
)



# Shannon diversity plot


p_shannon <- ggplot(
  alpha_gas,
  aes(
    x = GAS_isolated,
    y = Shannon,
    fill = GAS_isolated,
    colour = GAS_isolated
  )
) +
  ggdist::stat_halfeye(
    adjust = 0.5,
    width = 0.6,
    justification = -0.25,
    .width = 0,
    point_colour = NA,
    alpha = 0.95
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.08,
    size = 1.5,
    alpha = 0.45,
    colour = "grey55"
  ) +
  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.18,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    fill = "white",
    colour = "black",
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = gas_cols) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = gas_cols) +
  labs(
    x = "GAS status",
    y = "Shannon-Wiener index"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      colour = "black"
    ),
    axis.text = element_text(
      colour = "black",
      face = "bold"
    ),
    legend.position = "none"
  )


# Richness plot


p_richness <- ggplot(
  alpha_gas,
  aes(
    x = GAS_isolated,
    y = Richness,
    fill = GAS_isolated,
    colour = GAS_isolated
  )
) +
  ggdist::stat_halfeye(
    adjust = 0.5,
    width = 0.6,
    justification = -0.25,
    .width = 0,
    point_colour = NA,
    alpha = 0.95
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.08,
    size = 1.5,
    alpha = 0.45,
    colour = "grey55"
  ) +
  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.18,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    fill = "white",
    colour = "black",
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = gas_cols) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = gas_cols) +
  labs(
    x = "GAS status",
    y = "Chao1 richness"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      colour = "black"
    ),
    axis.text = element_text(
      colour = "black",
      face = "bold"
    ),
    legend.position = "none"
  )



# Mixed-effects models
# GAS-negative is the reference group


alpha_gas_model <- alpha_gas %>%
  mutate(
    GAS_isolated = relevel(
      factor(GAS_isolated),
      ref = "No"
    )
  )


# Shannon model
model_shannon <- lmer(
  Shannon ~ GAS_isolated + Event_name + (1 | participant_id),
  data = alpha_gas_model
)

summary(model_shannon)

confint(
  model_shannon,
  parm = "GAS_isolatedYes",
  method = "Wald"
)


# Richness model
model_richness <- lmer(
  Richness ~ GAS_isolated + Event_name + (1 | participant_id),
  data = alpha_gas_model
)

summary(model_richness)

confint(
  model_richness,
  parm = "GAS_isolatedYes",
  method = "Wald"
)



# Combine Figure 5A panels


figure5A <- p_shannon + p_richness +
  plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A")

figure5A
```

```{r}
# Figure 5E: Baseline microbiome and subsequent GAS acquisition

# Define GAS acquisition trajectory
#Baseline GAS-negative children only
gas_trajectory <- clinical %>%
  filter(
    EventName %in% c(
      "Screening_Visit_1",
      "Screening_Visit_2"
    ),
    GASIsolated %in% c("Yes", "No")
  ) %>%
  select(
    participant_id,
    EventName,
    GASIsolated
  ) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = EventName,
    values_from = GASIsolated
  ) %>%
  filter(
    Screening_Visit_1 == "No"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Acquisition = case_when(
      Screening_Visit_2 == "No" ~ "Remained GAS− (T2−)",
      Screening_Visit_2 == "Yes" ~ "Acquired GAS (T2+)",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Acquisition)
  )

table(
  gas_trajectory$Acquisition
)

baseline_meta <- clinical %>%
  filter(
    EventName == "Screening_Visit_1"
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    gas_trajectory %>%
      select(
        participant_id,
        Acquisition
      ),
    by = "participant_id"
  )

baseline_meta$Acquisition <- factor(
  baseline_meta$Acquisition,
  levels = c(
    "Remained GAS− (T2−)",
    "Acquired GAS (T2+)"
  )
)

alpha_acq <- baseline_meta %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Shannon),
    !is.na(Richness)
  )

wilcox_acquisition_shannon <- wilcox.test(
  Shannon ~ Acquisition,
  data = alpha_acq,
  exact = FALSE
)

wilcox_acquisition_chao1 <- wilcox.test(
  Richness ~ Acquisition,
  data = alpha_acq,
  exact = FALSE,
  correct = FALSE
)

wilcox_acquisition_shannon
wilcox_acquisition_chao1

sample_ids <- maaslin_abundance$sample_id

abundance_matrix <- maaslin_abundance %>%
  select(
    -sample_id
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      everything(),
      as.numeric
    )
  ) %>%
  as.data.frame()

rownames(abundance_matrix) <- sample_ids

baseline_beta <- baseline_meta %>%
  filter(
    Sample_ID %in% rownames(abundance_matrix)
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    match(
      Sample_ID,
      rownames(abundance_matrix)
    )
  )

abundance_baseline <- abundance_matrix[
  baseline_beta$Sample_ID,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

stopifnot(
  identical(
    rownames(abundance_baseline),
    baseline_beta$Sample_ID
  )
)

bray_baseline <- vegdist(
  abundance_baseline,
  method = "bray"
)

set.seed(123)

permanova_acquisition <- adonis2(
  bray_baseline ~ Acquisition,
  data = baseline_beta,
  permutations = 999
)

permanova_acquisition

pcoa_baseline <- cmdscale(

)

pcoa_df <- data.frame(

  ),

  left_join(
    baseline_beta %>%
      select(

      ),

  )

acq_cols <- c(
  "Remained GAS− (T2−)" = "#4C91C7",

)

R2_acq <- permanova_acquisition$R2[1]
p_perm_acq <- permanova_acquisition$`Pr(>F)`[1]

p_alpha <- ggplot(

  aes(
    x = Acquisition,

    width = 0.50,

    fill = NA,
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.12,
    size = 2,
    alpha = 0.85
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = acq_cols
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 1.5,
    y = max(
      alpha_acq$Shannon,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) + 0.10,
    label = "Wilcoxon p = 0.365",
    size = 3.5
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Baseline alpha diversity and subsequent GAS acquisition",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Baseline alpha diversity (Shannon)"
  ) +
  theme_classic(
    base_size = 11
  ) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 11
    ),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      face = "bold",
      size = 8,
      colour = "black"
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(
      colour = "black"
    ),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

p_pcoa <- ggplot(
  pcoa_df,
  aes(
    x = Acquisition,
    y = PCoA1,
    colour = Acquisition
  )
) +
  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.50,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    fill = NA,

  ) +
  geom_jitter(

  ) +
```

```{r}
### Figure 5F: GAS loss
gas_pairs <- clinical %>%
  filter(
    EventName %in% c("Screening_Visit_1", "Screening_Visit_2"),
    GASIsolated %in% c("Yes", "No")
  ) %>%
  select(
    participant_id,
    EventName,
    GASIsolated
  ) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = EventName,
    values_from = GASIsolated
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Screening_Visit_1),
    !is.na(Screening_Visit_2)
  )

table(
  gas_pairs$Screening_Visit_1,
  gas_pairs$Screening_Visit_2
)

gas_loss_ids <- gas_pairs %>%
  filter(
    Screening_Visit_1 == "Yes"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    GAS_trajectory = case_when(
      Screening_Visit_2 == "Yes" ~ "Persistent GAS",
      Screening_Visit_2 == "No" ~ "GAS loss",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(GAS_trajectory)
  ) %>%
  select(
    participant_id,
    GAS_trajectory
  )

table(
  gas_loss_ids$GAS_trajectory
)

gas_loss_meta <- clinical %>%
  filter(
    EventName == "Screening_Visit_1"
  ) %>%
  inner_join(
    gas_loss_ids,
    by = "participant_id"
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Sample_ID),
    Sample_ID %in% sample_names(physeq_bio)
  ) %>%
  distinct(
    Sample_ID,
    .keep_all = TRUE
  )

table(
  gas_loss_meta$GAS_trajectory
)

physeq_loss <- prune_samples(
  gas_loss_meta$Sample_ID,
  physeq_bio
)

physeq_loss <- prune_taxa(
  taxa_sums(physeq_loss) > 0,
  physeq_loss
)

stopifnot(
  setequal(
    sample_names(physeq_loss),
    gas_loss_meta$Sample_ID
  )
)

alpha_loss <- gas_loss_meta %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Shannon),
    !is.na(Richness)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    GAS_trajectory = factor(
      GAS_trajectory,
      levels = c(
        "Persistent GAS",
        "GAS loss"
      )
    )
  )

table(
  alpha_loss$GAS_trajectory
)

wilcox_loss_shannon <- wilcox.test(
  Shannon ~ GAS_trajectory,
  data = alpha_loss
)

wilcox_loss_chao1 <- wilcox.test(
  Richness ~ GAS_trajectory,
  data = alpha_loss,
  exact = FALSE,
  correct = FALSE
)

wilcox_loss_shannon
wilcox_loss_chao1

bray_loss <- phyloseq::distance(
  physeq_loss,
  method = "bray"
)

meta_loss <- gas_loss_meta[
  match(
    labels(bray_loss),
    gas_loss_meta$Sample_ID
  ),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

stopifnot(
  identical(
    labels(bray_loss),
    meta_loss$Sample_ID
  )
)

set.seed(123)

permanova_loss <- adonis2(
  bray_loss ~ GAS_trajectory,
  data = meta_loss,
  permutations = 999
)

permanova_loss

disp_loss <- betadisper(
  bray_loss,
  meta_loss$GAS_trajectory
)

set.seed(123)

permdisp_loss <- permutest(
  disp_loss,
  permutations = 999
)

permdisp_loss

ord_loss <- ordinate(
  physeq_loss,
  method = "PCoA",
  distance = bray_loss
)

pcoa_loss <- as.data.frame(
  ord_loss$vectors[, 1:2]
)

pcoa_loss$Sample_ID <- rownames(pcoa_loss)

trajectory_map <- setNames(
  as.character(gas_loss_meta$GAS_trajectory),
  gas_loss_meta$Sample_ID
)

pcoa_loss$GAS_trajectory <- unname(
  trajectory_map[pcoa_loss$Sample_ID]
)

alpha_loss$Figure_group <- factor(
  alpha_loss$GAS_trajectory,

    "Persistent GAS",

  ),
  labels = c(
    "Persistent GAS (T2+)",

)

pcoa_loss$Figure_group <- factor(

  ),
```
